period_note: Solo (bank-only) Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account from National Bank's Half-Yearly (2nd Quarter) 2022 unaudited financial statements; the plain 'Balance Sheet (Un-audited)'/'Profit and Loss Account (Un-audited)' sections (no 'Consolidated' prefix) were used, consistent with the annual Q4 series' Solo+OBU basis. Comparative column (31 Dec 2021) reproduces the known FY2021 figures exactly (total_assets 575060.76m, equity 51943.54m, gross_loans 445287.71m, total_deposits 473103.89m, nav_per_share 16.13). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2022 (the half-yearly filing's first of four P&L columns: [Jan-Jun 2022 cumulative] [Jan-Jun 2021 cumulative] [Apr-Jun 2022 discrete] [Apr-Jun 2021 discrete] -- the first column was used). As with Q1-2022, several subtotal lines in the source text ('Net interest income', 'Total operating income', 'Profit before provision') print without their negative sign even though the underlying value is a loss; corrected via the identity chain and cross-checked against the explicitly-parenthesized 'Profit before taxes (1,763,247,599)' and 'Net Profit after taxation (1,903,247,599)' lines, which are internally consistent. Source PDF was image-only; text obtained via OCR (tesseract, 300dpi).
